title: Device Return Clause of the Student Technology Device Program Loan Agreement
content:
## Return clause

1. A device of the Student Technology Device Program must be turned in within 5 calendar days after the student's last day of attendance when the student withdraws, and at the end of the school year when the loan type requires an end-of-year return, unless the student's grade is in the loan type's summer-keep grades.
2. A returned device is inspected and any damage found is charged under the program's damage charging rules.
3. A device not turned in by its deadline is charged the depreciated replacement cost; a device turned in later in the same school year credits that charge in full with the reason device recovered, less any damage charged on inspection.

## The withdrawal deadline

The clock starts on the student's last day of attendance, which is day 0, and counts calendar days.

| Hypothetical turn-in after a withdrawal | Within the deadline |
|---|---|
| Day 2 after the last day of attendance | Yes |
| Day 5 | Yes, day 5 is the last day |
| Day 6 | No |

## The deadlines in the clause

| Occasion | Deadline |
|---|---|
| The student withdraws | Within 5 calendar days after the last day of attendance |
| End of the school year, loan type requires an end-of-year return, grade not in the summer-keep grades | The end of the school year |
| End of the school year, grade in the summer-keep grades | No end-of-year turn-in |

## After a missed deadline

- The device not turned in by its deadline is charged its depreciated replacement cost.
- If it is turned in later in the same school year, that charge is credited in full with the reason device recovered, less any damage charged on inspection.
- Every returned device is inspected, and damage found on inspection is charged under the damage charging rules.
